1.consolidated_definition: Receptor. Persona que recibe algo, de lo que es beneficiario o destinatario. Desvío semántico, frecuente. DRAE 2001: utensilio destinado a guardar algo. Las regulaciones federales establecen que si el alumno recipiente de la beca Pell no completa 60% del programa académico al cual se matriculó, la institución debe devolver parte de ese dinero (El Nuevo Día, 21-11-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Recipient. Person who receives something, benefiting or being the intended recipient. Semantic shift, frequent. DRAE 2001: utensil designed to store something. Federal regulations establish that if the Pell grant recipient student does not complete 60% of the academic program they enrolled in, the institution must return part of that money (El Nuevo Día, November 21, 2007)
